tw-mi-benton-lake-stage-gold.st: The earliest print account found (1926) says only that the Pentwater-Big Rapids stage was held up where it skirted the lake, with no gold or burial mentioned. About 1906 a man from Montana came with a map, saying $72,000 of bank loot had been buried near the lake; locals helped search and found nothing.
src: Grand Rapids Press, 17 Aug 1926, p. 17 (earliest print)
